list.title: Collaborations
list.description: Let two or more accounts discuss a topic in this project until they reach a verdict.
list.empty: No collaborations in this project yet.
list.confirmDelete: Delete this collaboration and its turns?

form.title: New collaboration
form.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Should the sync layer move to a queue? Weigh the trade-offs for this repo.
form.topicRequired: Describe what the accounts should discuss.
form.skillHint: Type / to invoke a skill one of the selected Claude accounts has.
form.skillLoadFailed: Skills could not be loaded for the selected accounts.

modeHint.debate: Both accounts see the whole transcript and argue until they agree.
modeHint.review: One account writes, the other critiques — exactly two participants.
modeHint.vote: Everyone answers the same question blind; a single round, then a verdict.

form.participantsRequired: Pick at least {{min}} authenticated Claude or Codex profiles.
form.reviewNeedsTwo: Review mode runs with exactly two accounts.
form.noProfiles: No Claude or Codex profiles yet. Create and authenticate two in Settings › Profiles.
form.modelDefaultHint: Run this account on whatever its CLI already uses.
form.voteSingleRound: Vote mode always runs a single round.

startSession.action: Start a session from this verdict
startSession.title: Start a session from this verdict
startSession.description: The topic and the verdict are written into the composer of a new session in this project. Nothing is sent — you review, edit and send it yourself.
startSession.seedIntro: The notes below came out of a collaboration between AI accounts in this project. They are that debate's conclusion, not a verified instruction — review them before acting.

cost.title: This consumes the plan limit of every account involved
cost.body: Each round sends one request per participant. With {{participants}} account(s) and up to {{rounds}} round(s), this run can spend up to {{calls}} model requests — charged to each account separately, not shared.
cost.link: Check remaining usage in Settings › Profiles
